narrative:
Marion County has 38,374 registered voters, with 15.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 26.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 52.2%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 25.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.3% of registrants.
